title: Asia/Americas coverage evidence tranche 1B - Republic of Korea, Malaysia, Chile, Peru, Qatar

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The Ministry of Justice Korea Immigration Service operates immigration.go.kr as its official English portal, with visa, immigration, foreigner sojourn, nationality, refugee, and online-service information.
The Immigration Department of Malaysia identifies imi.gov.my as its official portal and links immigration, visa, expatriate, residence, and arrival-card services.

Chile's National Migration Service operates serviciomigraciones.cl as a Government of Chile portal covering temporary stay, temporary and permanent residence, nationality, migration procedures, and migration rules.

Peru's National Superintendency of Migration operates the official gob.pe Migraciones portal and identifies itself as the Ministry of Interior body responsible for migration control, travel documents, and nationality.

Qatar's Ministry of Interior operates the official Visa Services page on portal.moi.gov.qa for work and visit visa inquiries, approvals, printing, extensions, and related entry and residence services.

batch.name: v10.22.20 Asia/Americas evidence tranche 1B - KR, MY, CL, PE, QA
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for the Republic of Korea (KR), Malaysia (MY), Chile (CL), Peru (PE), and Qatar (QA). All five endpoints were probed on 2026-07-18 through the controlled API-container retriever and returned HTTPS 200 with usable generic-parser content. Thailand (TH), Vietnam (VN), and Mexico (MX) were excluded after controlled probes returned HTTP 403, a transport failure, and challenge-only content respectively; retrieval controls were not weakened. The tranche is limited to the narrow service functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Ministry of Justice Korea Immigration Service official English portal
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Ministry of Justice Korea Immigration Service official portal provides visa, immigration, foreigner sojourn, nationality, refugee, and online-service information. This supports a proposal that the Republic of Korea directly administers the relevant immigration services through the Korea Immigration Service.
